QuestInfo.name: Rooney's Breaking News
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9250052##k is apparently handing out flyers that contain the breaking news...
QuestInfo.1: Just received a flyer from #b#p9250052##k. The flyer stated that Happyville is in a state of emergency, and for more details, I have to visit #p1022101#.
QuestInfo.2: I asked #b#p1022101##k to inquire more on the stuff written on the flyer.

yes.0: Something urgent must be happening at Happyville. Rooney just asked me to hand these flyers out, and... if you want more information, you should go see her.

no.0: Ahhh... you must be uninterested in what was going on. It was deemed urgent, though... what should I do?? Anyway, if you are interested, please see me.

1.0: You must have read the flyer for you to make your way here. Yes, it's true... Happyville is in a stage of emergency. I need as much help as I can get, and...what do you think? Would you like to help us out?

yes.0: Thank you. Here's a little something for your good work...

item.0: Did you bring the flyer I asked you to bring? Did you meet up with the paperboy by any chance...?

lost.0: You lost that????? Sigh... please don't lose it again.

yes.0: With these flyers, #p1022101# will give a full detail of the information.
